summary: Clear, professional access request e-mails, and Microsoft system roles are no longer shown as gaps.

new.title: Professional access request e-mails
new.text: Every access request e-mail now shows your company name, the admin account to sign in with, the facts, the next steps and one button to the right page.

new.title: System roles shown as Not delegable
new.text: Discovery and gaps shows Microsoft system roles that cannot be given to a group as Not delegable, not as a gap. Nothing to do.

fixes.title: Owners can open the request from the e-mail
fixes.text: The approval e-mail now links straight to the request in PIM Manager, and the PIN e-mail links to the access request portal.
